input.label: SUPPORTED
input.reasoning_summary: The claim states that Meta's long-term debt was higher as of September 30, 2026 than at December 31, 2025. Evidence E3 and E1 both show the condensed consolidated balance sheet data comparing these two dates. Long-term debt was $80,922 million as of September 30, 2026 versus $58,744 million as of December 31, 2025. Since $80,922 million > $58,744 million, the claim is supported. The evidence also explains this increase was due to the issuance of $25 billion in new notes in May 2026 (E6), which increased the total face value of long-term debt from $59 billion to $84 billion (E1).
